tools.description:
Start a synthetic helper agent.
Choose by the recipient provider route. Native subscription GPT uses collaboration. External recipients, including GPT through OpenRouter, require collaboration_plaintext.spawn_agent for every assignment and follow-up, even when saved calls use native names. External children require fork_turns="none"; encrypted history cannot be translated.
When all subagent lanes are full, close finished agents, or all of them if needed, then retry spawn.
